raidAlertDescKick: {n} accounts joined in {s} seconds, much faster than usual. It could be a raid. Until things calm down, ARCHON will remove new members whose account is younger than {days}.
raidAlertDescAlert: {n} accounts joined in {s} seconds, much faster than usual. It could be a raid. ARCHON isn't removing anyone automatically (the minimum account age is set to 0), so you may want to look at the member list.
raidAlertFooter: ARCHON checks again every 5 minutes and tells you when things are back to normal.
raidClearedTitle: Things are back to normal in {server}
raidClearedDesc: Joins have slowed down again. ARCHON keeps watching.
raidKickDesc:
{server} was getting a lot of new members at once, and at those moments it removes accounts younger than {days}. Yours is {age} old, so you were removed. This isn't about anything you did.
You're welcome to join again in {left}.
strikeDmFooter: ARCHON CG-223 • One appeal per server per day
strikeOwnerDesc:
**Server:** {server}
Only you, the server owner, see this report.
strikeOwnerFooter: ARCHON CG-223 • Only the server owner sees this
strikeWhyLeft: {who} had already left the server, so there was nothing to do.
strikeWhyPerm:
I couldn't {verb} **{who}**: the **{bot}** role is missing **{perms}**.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → **{bot}** → turn on **{perms}**.
strikeWhyAdmin: I couldn't time out **{who}**: Discord doesn't allow timing out members who have the Administrator permission.
strikeWhyOwner: I couldn't act on **{who}**: they own the server, and Discord doesn't let anyone act on the owner.
strikeWhyRole:
I couldn't {verb} **{who}**: their highest role, **{role}**, sits above mine.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → drag **{bot}** above **{role}**.
strikeWhyUnknown: I couldn't {verb} **{who}**, and I couldn't tell why. The **postcheck** command and Server Settings → Roles are the best places to look.
